specification.objective: Refresh the now-functional reconstructed Kanban UI/UX so it matches TouchIn's established workspace language and becomes clearer, more fluid, more informative, and easier to operate without changing Kanban domain semantics, persistence, controller ownership, or dependencies.

requirements.statement: The Kanban page must adopt the same information hierarchy used by other TouchIn management pages: WorkspaceHeader for page intent, WorkspaceSectionCard for project context, compact metric items, and the existing accent navigation language, while retaining the dedicated safe Kanban page composition.
The selected project context must be immediately understandable through project identity, project selector, column count, card count, and project-team count without requiring interaction.

The board header must explain the primary interaction, surface synchronization/version state, provide horizontal navigation affordances when multiple columns exist, and retain an explicit create-column action.

Each lane must expose a clear title/count hierarchy, a focused add-card affordance, consolidated structural actions, a meaningful empty state, and stronger drop-target feedback without changing column identity or order semantics.

Cards must improve visual scanning with task-type badges, stronger title hierarchy, compact assignee summaries, clear edit/delete/assignee affordances, hover feedback, and an explicit drag handle while preserving card identity and raw-pointer movement behavior.
Drag feedback must be legible and dynamic: the dragged source visually recedes, the destination lane is emphasized, and the target position is communicated before release.

The page and board must remain responsive in narrow and wide viewports, preserve finite constraints under the production AppTheme, and avoid the intrinsic-layout and infinite-width failures fixed in prior increments.
No external dependency may be added. pubspec.yaml and the dependency graph must remain unchanged.

ProjectKanbanController remains the single owner of Kanban presentation state and server-authoritative persistence; backend, API, contracts, mutation sequencing, optimistic-concurrency behavior, and unrelated pages must not change.

The prior failed UI mechanisms must not be reintroduced: Draggable, DragTarget, LongPressDraggable, ReorderableListView, browser renderer workarounds, or a WorkspaceScaffold wrapping the dedicated Kanban board.

acceptance_criteria.statement: ProjectKanbanPage renders a WorkspaceHeader titled 'Kanban do projeto', a WorkspaceSectionCard for project context, a visible refresh action, and metric items labelled Colunas, Cards, and Equipe.
The accent top bar identifies TOUCHIN and Kanban, surfaces the selected project on wide viewports, and shows an updated/saving status without replacing the dedicated page layout.

ProjectKanbanBoard explains drag interaction, renders synchronization/version metadata, provides previous/next board navigation for multi-column boards, and keeps the Coluna action locally finite-width.
Lane headers show the column name and a separate card-count badge; structural actions are consolidated in a menu; every manageable lane exposes 'Adicionar card'; empty lanes explain how to start.
Cards display Bug/Melhoria/Feature badges, card number, title/description hierarchy, responsible-person summary, hover treatment, explicit drag affordance, and existing management actions.
During a drag the source card fades, the target lane receives an animated primary outline, and a 'Solte aqui' position indicator is rendered while persistence remains delegated to onMoveCard.

Focused widget coverage verifies the refreshed information hierarchy under AppTheme.darkTheme, retains the existing finite-layout/button regressions, and keeps the narrow viewport free of Flutter exceptions.
No pubspec or dependency file changes are present and project_kanban_board.dart contains no Draggable, DragTarget, LongPressDraggable, or ReorderableListView implementation.
Only the Kanban page, Kanban board widget, focused Kanban page test, and this versioned Change Contract are modified.

invariants.statement: ProjectKanbanController, TouchInApi, backend routes/services, Kanban contracts, and persistence semantics are byte-for-byte unchanged.
The dedicated Kanban page continues to use finite Column/Expanded layout and does not reintroduce the page-level SliverFillRemaining intrinsic-layout conflict.
Compact themed buttons placed in potentially loose horizontal contexts override their minimum size with finite widths.
The board continues to use CustomScrollView/SliverFixedExtentList and Listener-based raw pointer drag with persistent ScrollControllers.
pubspec.yaml is unchanged and no third-party Kanban package is introduced.

forbidden_states.statement: UI polish changes controller/backend/API/domain semantics or performs local persistent optimistic reordering ahead of the authoritative server response.
A new external package or third-party Kanban implementation is added.
Draggable, DragTarget, LongPressDraggable, ReorderableListView, or browser-specific renderer flags return to the implementation.
The UI uses intrinsic sizing or an inherited Size.fromHeight button minimum in an unbounded Row, recreating prior rendering failures.
Unrelated workspace pages or the global AppTheme are modified merely to style the Kanban.

inputs.statement: Current functional baseline tree ca5708ec3a0819a030738fb5861a47a46efafcfb after the reconstructed board, finite page layout, and finite Kanban header button fixes.

Existing TouchIn management pages use WorkspaceHeader, WorkspaceSectionCard, compact metric rows, accent branding, clear empty states, and explicit management actions as the visual/interaction reference.
User requirement: improve the working Kanban comprehensively so it feels more fluid, interesting, dynamic, and easier to understand, without external dependencies.

outputs.statement: A refreshed ProjectKanbanPage aligned with TouchIn workspace hierarchy and project context patterns.
A refreshed ProjectKanbanBoard with clearer lanes/cards, interaction guidance, hover/drop feedback, and explicit empty/add states.
Focused regression coverage for production-theme rendering and refreshed UX landmarks without changing dependencies or Kanban domain behavior.

failure_semantics.statement: If the refreshed UI landmarks are absent, the regression command exits non-zero with kanban_uiux_refresh_missing.
If a new Flutter rendering exception appears, the first concrete layout exception is authoritative and the UI increment must be corrected locally rather than changing renderer/backend architecture.
If behavior, API, or persistence changes are required to realize a visual affordance, that affordance is out of scope for this increment.
